css: .t8-shell{font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172033;background:#f7f8fb;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:16px;padding:15px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden}.t8-shell header p{margin:0;color:#6c7688;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:10px}.t8-shell header h2{margin:2px 0 12px;font-size:20px}.t8-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.t8-actions button{appearance:none;border:1px solid #cbd3df;background:white;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;color:#253047;cursor:pointer}.t8-actions button[data-save]{background:#2447bd;color:white;border-color:#2447bd}.t8-actions button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.t8-status{margin:11px 0;padding:9px 10px;background:#eef3fb;border:1px solid #d2dcef;border-radius:9px;color:#334a78}.t8-status[data-kind="error"]{background:#fff1f1;border-color:#efc5c5;color:#872727}.t8-status[data-kind="ok"]{background:#eef9f2;border-color:#cce7d5;color:#27663d}.t8-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.t8-summary>div{background:white;border:1px solid #dde2ea;border-radius:9px;padding:9px;min-width:0}.t8-summary span,.t8-summary strong{display:block}.t8-summary span{font-size:10px;color:#6a7486}.t8-summary strong{margin-top:2px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.t8-help{margin:10px 0 0;color:#667186;font-size:11px}@media(max-width:680px){.t8-summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
js: const KEY='bci.snapshot.bci-20260915-054423-2721a9952ab3';const statusEl=root.querySelector('[data-status]');const savedEl=root.querySelector('[data-saved]');const undoEl=root.querySelector('[data-undo-state]');const taskCount=root.querySelector('[data-task-count]');const sectionEl=root.querySelector('[data-section]');const undoBtn=root.querySelector('[data-undo]');let undoState=null;function pickSnapshot(){const s=api.cloneState();return{projects:s.projects||[],activeProjectId:s.activeProjectId??null,tasks:s.tasks||[],notes:s.notes??{},workspaceSection:s.workspaceSection||'Overview'};}function setStatus(text,kind){statusEl.textContent=text;statusEl.dataset.kind=kind||'';}function readSaved(){try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(KEY);return raw?JSON.parse(raw):null;}catch(e){return null;}}function render(){const saved=readSaved();savedEl.textContent=saved?'Yes':'No';undoEl.textContent=undoState?'Yes':'No';undoBtn.disabled=!undoState;taskCount.textContent=String((api.getState('tasks')||[]).length);sectionEl.textContent=api.getState('workspaceSection')||'Overview';}root.querySelector('[data-save]').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify({schema:'bci.snapshot.v1',savedAt:new Date().toISOString(),state:pickSnapshot()}));setStatus('Snapshot saved from the current shared state.','ok');api.log(8,'Snapshot saved');}catch(e){setStatus('Snapshot could not be saved: '+e.message,'error');}render();});root.querySelector('[data-restore]').addEventListener('click',()=>{const saved=readSaved();if(!saved||!saved.state){setStatus('No saved snapshot is available to restore.','error');render();return;}undoState=api.cloneState();api.replaceState({...undoState,...saved.state});setStatus('Snapshot restored. Mounted modules were notified through shared state.','ok');api.log(8,'Snapshot restored');render();});root.querySelector('[data-clear]').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{localStorage.removeItem(KEY);setStatus('Saved snapshot cleared. Current shared state was not changed.','ok');api.log(8,'Saved snapshot cleared');}catch(e){setStatus('Saved state could not be cleared: '+e.message,'error');}render();});undoBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!undoState){setStatus('There is no change to undo.','error');return;}const target=undoState;undoState=api.cloneState();api.replaceState(target);setStatus('Last restore change undone. Shared state returned to its previous values.','ok');api.log(8,'Last shared-state change undone');render();});render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);root.addEventListener('bci:unmount',unsubscribe,{once:true});
